shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; echo '--- registry ---'; sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; echo '--- spec ---'; sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; echo '--- commands ---'; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; echo '--- package scripts ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({scripts:p.scripts,version:p.version},null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"ToolDefinitionSource|inputSchema|validated by|execute\\(\" src/orchestration specs scripts | head -160; sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; git status --short; git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test tools: cover dynamic input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
